Fetch HTTP headers only

Fetches only the HTTP response headers.

curl -I https://example.com

http, curl, headers

Trace DNS resolution path

Follows the DNS delegation path from root servers.

dig +trace <domain>

dns, dig

Test TCP port connectivity

Uses netcat to check if a remote TCP port is reachable.

nc -vz <hostname> <port>

tcp, connectivity, nc

Capture packets on port

Captures and displays raw network traffic on a specific port.

sudo tcpdump -i any port 80 -n -v

tcpdump, packets, sniffing

Check a remote TLS certificate's expiry

Fetches and displays the expiration date of a remote SSL certificate.

echo | openssl s_client -servername example.com -connect example.com:443 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -dates

ssl, tls, certificate

Format JSON with jq

Fetches a JSON API response and formats it nicely using jq.

curl -s https://api.github.com/users/octocat | jq '.'

Test Nginx configuration

Tests the Nginx config files for syntax errors before reloading.

sudo nginx -t

nginx, config, test

Reload Nginx gracefully

Reloads the Nginx configuration without dropping active connections.

sudo nginx -s reload

Monitor Nginx access logs

Tails the Nginx access logs and uses awk to show only IPs and HTTP status.

tail -f /var/log/nginx/access.log | awk '{print $1, $9}'

nginx, logs, awk

Check IP routing

Determines exactly which interface and route will be used to reach an IP.

ip route get 8.8.8.8

Ping via specific interface

Forces ping to use a specific network interface.

Network path analysis (mtr)

Combines ping and traceroute for real-time network path analysis.
